questions_and_answers.question: The nurse has applied a sling to a client who has an arm injury. Which assessment finding requires the nurse to further intervene? a. Capillary refill time is 4 seconds. b. Skin temperature is warm to touch. c. Client reports arm pain of "3" on scale of 1-10. d. No edema noted.
questions_and_answers.answer: Capillary refill time is 4 seconds.Capillary refill should be 2 seconds or less. If it is greater than 2 seconds, circulation may be impaired, which requires nursing intervention. All other findings are normal.
